name: AccuTile
definition: An algorithm for identifying the minimum and maximum points (extents) of an ellipse within a given tile row or column during rasterization, used to determine which pixels to render. It improves upon SnugBox by handling cases where the ellipse intersects tile boundaries more precisely.
summary: AccuTile is an algorithm that precisely identifies tiles intersected by a projected Gaussian by computing exact ellipse extents, reducing tile counts more effectively than SnugBox.
